maintenance_led.reason: Majority of sales are aftermarket parts and consumables like doctor blades, rotary joints, and spare parts for installed paper-machine equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private paper, packaging, tissue, wood products and other process-industry manufacturers paying for equipment and parts.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own product lines and aftermarket, though it makes regular bolt-on acquisitions alongside organic growth.

mission_critical.reason: Engineered rotary joints, steam systems and doctoring are specified into customers' machines; switching risks downtime and requalification.

notes: Kadant also reports a Papermaking Systems and Material Handling segment; aftermarket share judged from general knowledge, with some capital equipment.
